newsitem.title: USA: Barringer Technologies offers 1 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Barringer Technologies offers 1 mln shares.

text.p: Barringer Technologies Inc said Friday it has filed to offer one million shares of its common stock and one million common stock purchase warrants.
Company President Kenneth Wood said the company plans to use the proceeds to support continuing development, for working capital, and for other general business purposes.
No target price for the offering has been set, he said.
Barringer develops, manufactures and sells analytical instruments that are used to detect trace amounts of plastic and other explosives and illegal drugs.
